shortlist.author: self
shortlist.quote:
I put my phone on airplane mode 10 days ago. I wasn’t sure I could actually do it.

I could… mostly. I used it as I needed. Not too many moments more. I’m still quite surprised by that, as I type this now. 

10 days outside. Walking. Talking. Playing. Family get togethers, sunny walks up hills, along canals and actually in rivers. My four-year-old scrambling up Ilkley's Cow and Calf like it was nothing - more physically confident on those rocks than I’ve seen him in a while.

Then three days without him, without my parents, at the other end of the country. Lunch by the river Cam with a friend I’ve known for almost 20 years (and some ambling cows). No notifications. No half-listening. Just two people, actually there.

I noticed something in those first few Yorkshire days. The urge to check had actually gone quiet. Not disciplined away, actually just gone, because there was something far more interesting in front of me than a screen. And, honestly, I felt such peace and calm 💗

Today, I'm back to work - with my phone on airplane mode as much as possible 🙏🏻

shortlist.author: self
shortlist.quote:
She introduced herself with a story that stopped being true years ago.

The one about not being quite ready. Not quite experienced enough. Not the kind of woman who does the big, bold thing... not yet.

Except she was. She had been for a long time. The evidence was everywhere, the track record, the respect she commanded, the people who already looked to her. Everyone could see it.

Except her.

...The work wasn't building her up. She was already built. The work was helping her notice she'd been describing a woman who no longer existed.

And when she updated the story to match who she'd actually become, everything she'd been hesitating over stopped looking so impossible. She hadn't been lacking anything. She'd just been carrying an old map.

If you're still introducing yourself as a version of you that you left behind years ago, it might be time to check the date on the story.

What are you still holding back from, on the strength of something that stopped being true a long time ago?

#womeninleadership #liberation #GAIArises #community
